Various tools to sniff network traffic for cleartext insecuritiesThis package contains several tools to listen to and create network traffic:
arpspoof - Send out unrequested (and possibly forged) arp replies.
dnsspoof - forge replies to arbitrary DNS address / pointer queries
on the Local Area Network.
dsniff - password sniffer for several protocols.
filesnarf - saves selected files sniffed from NFS traffic.
macof - flood the local network with random MAC addresses.
mailsnarf - sniffs mail on the LAN and stores it in mbox format.
